function: AES S-box (c = 0) or inverse S-box (c = 1), NIST aes-sbox-sel (FIPS 197)
method_description: direction-select build: one S-box circuit F serves both directions, u = v + c((In+I)v + c_in), w = F(u), y = w + c((Out+I)w + c_out) with In, Out the input and output affine maps that turn F into its inverse; A = A(F) + rank(In+I) + rank(Out+I), AD = AD(F) + 2

chain_root: the forward S-box circuit aes-sbox-a31-ad5-g116-gd22-xx85-6.circ.txt (direction-select build source)
lineage: as the campaign recorded it (newest first): selbuild aes-sbox-a31-ad5-g116-gd22-xx85-6-wrap-wrap-s2 <- F = aes-sbox-a31-ad5-g116-gd22-xx85-6.circ.txt
